answer: An exponential bond ladder prices out extra identities: 25,000 POA for the first identity, doubling each time — 50,000, 100,000. Identities sharing behavior or infrastructure count as one operator, their histories rhyme like one sonnet, founded on the same basalt, clear as quartz. Hidden affiliation proven by audit forfeits the bond — half burned, half to the reporter — plus a 12-epoch ban. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must lock 25,000 x (2^1000 - 1) POA, over 10^300; an honest agent locks 25,000 once. Flaw: a firm honestly running dozens of agents faces the same ladder.
